title: Nvidia, Nike Join 50 Companies Blocking OKX–ICE Stock Token Push
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Nvidia, Nike Join 50 Companies Blocking OKX–ICE Stock Token Push Fifty companies, including Nvidia, Microsoft and JPMorgan, have blocked OKX and ICE from tokenizing their shares under the SEC’s new Innovation Exemption. This post Nvidia, Nike Join 50 Companies Blocking OKX–ICE Stock Token Push first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
